promptTemplate: Use case: illustration-story. Create one portrait illustration for a Yoga Sudhakara reading card. Subject: {scene} Style: rich detailed painterly engraving, deep black shadows and electric fire orange ember highlights, restrained cream highlights, contemplative dignified atmosphere, ancient Indian setting where applicable. Full bleed vertical composition 2:3. No text, letters, labels, borders or watermark. Each scene must visually communicate its specific philosophical metaphor.

scenes.scene: A student entering an Indian forest hermitage through a stone doorway, teacher with palm-leaf manuscript and oil lamp. The beginning of Yoga, sutra 1.1.
A black mountain lake, restless concentric ripples becoming perfectly still around one unwavering reflection of a flame. Yoga is the cessation of the movements of mind, sutra 1.2.
One seated contemplative beside two pools, one perfectly reflecting the moon, the other broken by waves. The seer resting in its own nature versus identifying with mental fluctuations, 1.3–1.4.

Five separate streams emerge from a mountain spring and flow through distinct landscapes: a clear crystal, a distorted reflection, swirling mist, a dark cave, ancient tree rings. Five activities of mind, 1.5–1.11.
A solitary practitioner ascending worn stone steps beside a river, many tiny oil lamps mark years of patient steady practice. Abhyasa, 1.12–1.14.
An open relaxed hand releasing golden autumn leaves into a river; a simple meditator behind, distant palace fading into fog. Vairagya, 1.15–1.16.
Four ascending mountain terraces each supporting a quiet meditator, progressing from a stone object to a luminous subtle horizon. Four stages of conscious absorption, 1.17.
Five lamps along a dark mountain trail lead to an empty luminous sanctuary beyond all form. Faith, energy, memory, concentration and wisdom, 1.18–1.22.
A pure luminous flame at the center of a translucent crystal untouched by a storm of dark threads and wind outside. Ishvara untouched by affliction, karma and time, 1.24–1.26.

An ancient bronze singing bowl in a quiet Indian shrine radiates concentric luminous sound waves through darkness toward a solitary meditator. Pranava and contemplation, 1.27–1.29. No letters or Om text.
Nine dark rough stones block a stream that gathers into one clear current, an unwavering lamp on its bank. Obstacles and single-pointed practice, 1.30–1.32.
Seven small stone niches in a banyan grove each hold a lamp, a tranquil meditator in foreground with a warm open gesture of compassion. Seven ways to settle the mind, 1.33–1.39.
A large flawless transparent quartz crystal on black stone beside a flower and lamp, crystal faithfully reflecting the colors of what surrounds it. Crystal-like absorption, 1.40–1.45.
An empty quiet earthen bowl beside a small pile of completely burned seeds and a dying ember; infinite clear sky beyond. Seedless absorption, 1.46–1.51.
Three objects in an Indian hermitage: a disciplined sacred fire, an open palm-leaf manuscript, and folded hands offered toward a glowing shrine. Austerity, self-study, surrender, 2.1–2.2.
Five dark tangled roots grip a translucent heart-shaped stone; a careful hand loosens the roots by lamplight. Ignorance, ego, attachment, aversion, clinging, 2.3–2.11.
An ancient wheel casts a repeating shadow on a path; a seeker steps out of the wheel's track into clear light. Karma, suffering and discerning the seer from the seen, 2.12–2.27.
Eight stone steps lead from a grove to a mountain meditation pavilion; at the base, open hands gently protect a small deer. Eight limbs of yoga and ethical foundation, 2.28–2.45.
A dignified seated yogi in a stable posture, subtle warm flowing breath ribbons, lotus petals gently closing around a quiet center. Posture, breath regulation, withdrawal of senses, 2.46–2.55.
Three rivers converge into one luminous stream that flows toward a lamp at the center of a still circular pool. Concentration, meditation and absorption united as samyama, 3.1–3.8.
Three earthen vessels in a potter's quiet workshop, raw clay, shaped form, and a finished bowl reflecting a steady lamp. Three transformations of consciousness, 3.9–3.16.

A contemplative meditator on a rocky ledge beneath luminous constellations, sun and moon, subtle waves connecting the natural world. Powers described through samyama, 3.17–3.49. Contemplative symbolic scene, not superhero.
A seeker walks past floating jewels and a radiant palace toward a simple clear mountain horizon, refusing distraction. Discernment beyond powers, 3.50–3.56.
One oil lamp lights several other separate lamps on a stone terrace; each flame casts a different pattern into the same dark night. Sources of powers and created minds, 4.1–4.6.
A luminous moon shines above a still lake with several vessels of water each reflecting the same moon, one clear quartz beside them. Mind, consciousness and objects, 4.7–4.24.
A vast glowing monsoon cloud rains soft luminous drops over a silent Indian forest and solitary seated sage. Cloud of virtue, dharmamegha samadhi, 4.25–4.30.
An opened empty birdcage on a mountain ledge, a bird soaring into boundless sunrise, three colored threads lying still on the stone. Kaivalya, absolute freedom, 4.31–4.34.
